title: Code and data for: Finite-Shot Operating Windows for Virtual Distillation and Symmetry Verification
description: Reproduction package for the numerical experiments and figures accompanying the paper on finite-shot operating windows for virtual distillation (VD) and symmetry verification (SV). Includes white-box coefficient validation, certified-crossing experiments, and (Phase B) device-simulation robustness runs and archived hardware counts. Author metadata is anonymized for blinded review and is updated at de-blinding.
